Let's merge this and parent patch into a single patch since they are closely related.

Done. 
Have the inventory-sensor association implementation merged in the latest patch.
Create a single function local object for processor inventory object path and pass it to each sensor class constructor.

Done.
I have modified `setInitialProperties` in `sensor.hpp`.
The function is now able to have an extra input `inventoryPath` with default value as an empty string.
Also, I have added an if-else logic to distinguish whether to create only chassis-sensor association or both inventory-sensor and chassis-sensors associations.
Is this object being used outside the constructor? If not, there is no need for it to be member data of the class.

Done!
Have the member data removed, `inventoryPath` would only be used once and discarded after the constructor.

Let's update sensor.hpp file and add optional function parameter for container of inventory object paths and create the association within sensor.hpp. Update the commit message specifying that this association is already documented in PDI.
Done.
Make this std::optional. Same for other sensor classes.

Done. The constructors of `NvidiaGpuSensor`, `NvidiaGpuPowerSensor`, `NvidiaGpuEnergySensor`, and `NvidiaGpuVoltageSensor` now take `const std::optional<std::string>& inventoryPath`, defaulting to `std::nullopt` for sensors that should not have the inventory->sensors association.
Let's make this std::vector to accommodate multiple associated paths. Suggest renaming parameter to associatedPaths since they are not limited to only inventories.

Thanks for the suggestion. After re-reading the document in the following link:
`https://github.com/openbmc/docs/blob/master/architecture/sensor-architecture.md`

I would prefer to keep the parameter as `const std::optional<std::string>& inventoryPath` rather than `std::vector<std::string>& associatedPaths` for 2 reasons:

1. The function only ever emits the two association pairs documented for sensors - `chassis`/`all_sensors` and `inventory`/`sensors` - and the chassis path is derived internally from `configurationPath`. So the only thing the caller actually supplies is an inventory item path. Renaming to `associationPaths` would suggest the caller can pass non-inventory paths, which the function does not support.

2. For the GPU sensors in this patch, each sensor monitors exactly one hardware item (its parent GPU), so a single `std::optional` cleanly expresses "this sensor has one inventory parent, or none." I would prefer to keep the API matched to the actual usage rather than pre-generalize.

If a future use case emerges where one sensor genuinely needs to associate with multiple inventory items. I'm happy to change the signature to `std::vector` then. Does that work for you?
LGTM, +1.
